app.name: EcoTime
app.footer: Shenhai EcoTime · trusted time for Shenhai B2X
nav.label: Main
admin.label: Operator
welcome.title: Time you can check
welcome.text: EcoTime gives Shenhai apps one trusted clock, correct time-zone conversion and schedules that run once, on time, even across daylight-saving changes.
ecoid.failed: Sign-in with EcoID did not complete. Please try again.
adminLogin.title: Operator sign-in
adminLogin.text: For EcoTime operators only. EcoID accounts cannot sign in here.
adminLogin.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from Shenhai Authenticator.
adminLogin.notAdmin: Not an operator? Continue with EcoID
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.pageTitle: This page could not be shown
error.page: The rest of EcoTime still works. Try another page or reload.
error.INVALID_TIME_ZONE: That is not an IANA time zone. Use a name such as Africa/Nairobi, not a fixed offset.
error.INVALID_RECURRENCE: That repeat rule is not accepted. Check the frequency and interval.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request was already used with different details.
error.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this schedule meanwhile. Reload and try again.
error.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Your organization has reached its schedule limit.
error.NOT_FOUND: Not found, or you do not have access.
error.SCOPE_MISSING: This credential is not allowed to do that.
error.ADMIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Operator accounts cannot sign in with EcoID.
error.OFFLINE: You are offline. EcoTime needs a connection to read the server clock.
offline.banner: You are offline. Times shown may be out of date.
settings.languageText: EcoTime and the emails it sends use this language.
settings.zoneText: Times are shown in this zone. Leave empty to follow this device ({zone}).
settings.ecoidText: You sign in with EcoID. EcoTime keeps no password for you.
skew.title: This device's clock
skew.same: This device agrees with EcoTime (within ±{u} ms).
skew.behind: This device is {ms} ms behind EcoTime (±{u} ms).
skew.ahead: This device is {ms} ms ahead of EcoTime (±{u} ms).
skew.text: Measured from the round trip to the server; the margin is half the round trip. EcoTime never relies on the device clock.
health.title: Server clock health
health.mismatchText: The runtime and the operating system use different time-zone rule versions. EcoTime calculates with the runtime rules and records the mismatch; future schedules are recalculated when the runtime rules change.
clock.synchronized.text: The server clock is synchronized and within limits.
clock.degraded.text: The server clock is synchronized but outside a limit. Times are still usable; see the reason.
clock.unsynchronized.text: The synchronization daemon reports the clock is not synchronized. Do not rely on precise times until this clears.
clock.stale.text: No recent observation of the clock. Its state is not known to be good.
clock.unknown.text: EcoTime cannot read the clock's state, so it makes no claim about it.
convert.localText: Enter a wall-clock time in a zone. EcoTime tells you the exact instant, and what happens if that time does not exist or happens twice.
convert.instantText: Enter a time as read in one zone to see it in another.
dst.gap: If the time does not exist (clocks go forward)
dst.gap.shift_forward: Move it forward by the gap
dst.overlap: If the time happens twice (clocks go back)
resolution.unique.text: This local time happens exactly once.
resolution.ambiguous.text: Clocks go back here, so this local time happens twice. The chosen rule picks one.
resolution.nonexistent.text: Clocks go forward here, so this local time never happens. The chosen rule decides what to do.
resolution.skippedText: The rule says to skip a time that does not exist.
schedules.newText: A schedule keeps your intent: a local time in a zone. EcoTime works out each instant from that, so daylight-saving changes never move your 09:00.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.cancelConfirm: Cancel "{name}"? It will not run again.
action.record.text: Each run is recorded in the history. Nothing is sent.
action.email.text: An email is sent at each run.
action.webhook.text: A signed HTTPS request is sent to the organization's webhook, with the same idempotency key on every retry.
zones.text: All IANA time zones. A country with several zones lists them all, so choose the one for your place.
zones.dst: This zone changes its clocks. Next changes:
zones.noDst: This zone does not change its clocks in the coming year.
support.text: Tell us what went wrong. You can also write to {email}.
support.subject: Subject
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.identity.title: Who you are
privacy.identity.text: You sign in with EcoID. EcoTime keeps your EcoID identifier, display name, language and chosen time zone. Your email address is never used to identify you.
privacy.schedules.title: Your schedules
privacy.schedules.text: EcoTime keeps the schedules you create, their runs and any email address or message you put in them, so that they can run.
privacy.clock.title: Clock measurements
privacy.clock.text: To show this device's clock difference, the page compares it with the server. The result stays in your browser.
privacy.logs.title: Records
privacy.logs.text: Sign-ins and changes are recorded in an audit log that cannot be edited.
privacy.thirdparty.title: Others
privacy.thirdparty.text: EcoTime does not sell or share your data. Webhooks send only what the schedule's organization set up.
privacy.retention.title: How long
privacy.retention.text: Clock observations are kept for 30 days; run history and records for the periods set by Shenhai's retention policy.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
sources.title: Time sources
sources.text: Where the server's synchronization daemon gets time from. This list documents them; the daemon's own configuration decides which it uses.
sources.addText: Record a source after adding it to the server's daemon configuration.
sources.singleText: The clock depends on a single server. If it is wrong or unreachable there is nothing to compare with. Add independent sources to the daemon.
events.title: Clock events
obs.title: Observations (24 hours)
obs.text: Kept every 5 minutes, and whenever the state changes.
obs.none: No observations yet. Is the collector timer running?
rulesets.title: Time-zone rule versions
rulesets.text: Each change of the runtime's rules recalculates future runs from their intent.
orgs.text: Apps and teams own schedules, webhooks and API keys. Each person also has a personal organization.
orgs.name: Name
clients.text: For other Shenhai apps. A key belongs to one organization and sees only its schedules.
clients.name: Name
clients.keyOnce: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
clients.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? Apps using it stop working at once.
webhooks.text: HTTPS only, on approved Shenhai domains. Each call is signed with the webhook's secret.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy this signing secret now. It will not be shown again.
webhooks.verifyText: Compute the HMAC with the secret and compare it with v1; reject old timestamps; use the idempotency key to ignore repeats.
webhooks.disableConfirm: Disable "{name}"? Schedules using it will fail.
users.text: People who signed in with EcoID.
users.name: Name
activity.text: The audit log. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.subject: Subject
